trait_wfx_bendecido_obelisco_info: Touched the old stone and the stone answered.
trait_wfx_cazador_bestias_info: Has felled what frightened the children.
trait_wfx_chismoso_info: Knows everyone's business and tells it.
trait_wfx_desterrado_info: Driven from their town. They don't forget.
trait_wfx_juramentado_info: Swore loyalty to the realm and keeps it.
trait_wfx_maldito_info: Something follows them. Everything goes a bit worse.
trait_wfx_peregrino_info: Has walked to the holy places.
trait_wfx_pretendiente_info: Believes a crown is theirs by right.
trait_wfx_vengador_info: Lives to settle a blood debt.
trait_wfx_voz_del_pueblo_info: People listen to them and follow.
wfx_amuleto_luto_description: Carved from the bone of someone loved.
wfx_amuleto_pecera_description: Its wearer hears the rumours before anyone.
wfx_anillo_obelisco_description: Warm to the touch. It hums before a storm.
wfx_arco_elfico_description: Light as a branch, sure as a hawk.
wfx_arco_hueso_dragon_description: Strung with dragon sinew. Few can even bend it.
wfx_armadura_escamas_dragon_description: Neither fire nor steel pierce it easily.
wfx_bendicion_description: Bless the person you touch: mana, health and renown. The fishbowl will remember.
wfx_bestia_description: Release a huge named beast. Opens a hunt quest.
wfx_botas_peregrino_description: They have walked more roads than their owner.
wfx_capucha_rastreador_description: It smells of forest. No one hears you coming.
wfx_coraza_juramentada_description: Engraved with the oath of whoever wears it.
wfx_destierro_description: Drive the person you touch out of their town (never a king).
wfx_discordia_description: The person you touch falls out with their best friend (fishbowl: grievance and rumours).
wfx_espada_obsidiana_description: Volcanic stone honed to cut the air.
wfx_espada_rey_caido_description: It belonged to a king. His people still know it.
wfx_juramento_description: The person you touch swears loyalty to their realm.
wfx_lanza_cazador_description: Cured wood and a bone tip: for big game.
wfx_maldicion_description: Curse the person you touch. Everything goes a bit worse for them.
wfx_martillo_trueno_description: Every blow sounds like a distant storm.
wfx_reconciliacion_description: The person you touch makes peace with their rival (in the fishbowl).
wfx_yelmo_heredero_description: Made for a head waiting for a crown.
